svg.title: Cloud contact centre for ThinkFinance MFB
svg.desc: Customers call the bank or open a chat widget on its website, which only runs on allowlisted domains. Both channels enter one Amazon Connect contact flow that checks Africa/Lagos business hours. In hours, the contact joins an agent queue and is routed to an agent in the Contact Control Panel. Out of hours, Amazon Polly reads a closed message and the contact ends.

text.tspan: Cloud contact centre for ThinkFinance MFB
An omnichannel Amazon Connect contact centre: voice and web chat share one flow that follows Lagos business hours.
Customers call the bank, or open chat on its website.
The chat widget only starts a session from allowlisted bank domains.
Both channels enter one flow that checks Lagos business hours.
In hours, the contact joins a queue and is routed to an available agent.
Out of hours, Polly reads the closed message and the contact ends cleanly.
